body.x: Algocare (CEO Ji-won Joung) participated in the 'Startup Zone' at the Eureka Park K-STARTUP integrated hall of 'CES 2023' in Las Vegas, USA from January 5 (Thursday) to 8 (Sunday, local time) for a total of 4 days.

Algocare is a total healthcare solution business that provides real-time, customized 1:1 nutrition management services (Nutrition as a Service, NaaS) based on artificial intelligence. With its B2B office nutrition management solution Algocare at Work, the business provides services to major enterprises in South Korea. The company is responsible for boosting not just the nutritional health of individual employees but corporate productivity. Its own research center Algocare Labs is staffed with doctors, pharmacists, and data scientists from Seoul National University to advance healthcare artificial intelligence, and has been recognized for its innovation of IoT nutrition appliance Algocare Nutrition Engine in CES.

In this years’ CES, Algocare introduced a more enhanced solution called NaaS Plus+. It is currently under development to be launched in March, 2023 and will feature facial and voice diagnostics to free users from the hassle of self-care, enabling them to focus on their health.

According to a representative from Algocare, “Our healthcare AI analyzes data whereas Nutrition Engine Plus collects daily health conditions through selection as well as facial and voice diagnostics. Based on this, the engine produces an accurate and personalized combination of nutrients using a 4 mm-sized supplement. The data is automatically accumulated, and users can easily check all the data through the app.”

Algocare differentiates itself by shifting the nutrition market focus from products to users. It leverages ICT to automate the process of personalized nutrition management, allowing users to focus on their health, while automatically collecting and analyzing health information for more reliable health management.

“Following the CES 2022 exhibition, we successfully launched Algocare at Work, the Proof-of-Concept (PoC) service, in the domestic market, helping large enterprises boost employee health care and their productivity. The PoC service experience helped us identify the areas for improvement and accelerate the development of NaaS Plus+. Based on our progress, we were able to win the CES Innovation Award for third years in a row,” explained the representative.

When asked about their plans going forward, the representative replied, “Algocare started with nutrition care services that users seek on a daily basis, providing health information without burdening our users. Our current priority is to upgrade the service model of Algocare at Work and to spread its presence among domestic businesses.”

“In addition, we are going to introduce a genetic testing service and an intestinal microbiology testing service in 2023 for a precise ultra-personalization. A mental care service will be launched for nutrition management and synergy creation based on the accumulated health data.” The representative added, “By the end of 2023, an entry-level Algocare at Home service will also be launched and mass produced for ordinary users to use at home.”

‘CES’ is the world’s biggest IT trade show and is a place where one can see the direction and trends of the appliance industry of the entire world. Hosted by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), it is held annually in Las Vegas, USA in January. Having reported on CES for 17 consecutive years, AVING News started reporting news of CES to the entire world since 2006, and conducted ‘BEST OF CES’, which chose the most innovative product and technology, and ‘BEST OF MADE IN KOREA, which chose the best innovative company in Korea. In addition, it vividly relayed on-site issues in CES through ‘AVING LIVE’.

The K-STARTUP Joint Pavilion featured joint participation of institutions like the Korea Institute of Startup & Entrepreneurship Development, Seoul Business Agency, and Seoul Digital Foundation, as well as 51 Korean innovative companies, to enter the US market and discover global partners. In addition, university student supporters of CES 2023 chosen by each university (Kyunghee, Kookmin, Sogang, Chung-Ang) matched to participating companies based on their respective majors and fields of business.
